svg.title: Keep-out around through-hole pins for selective soldering
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, solder side of the board. A row of three through-hole pads on a 2.54 mm pitch, with traces under the mask. A white dashed line marks the recommended keep-out, 3 mm beyond the outer edge of the pads on three sides and 5 mm on the side where the board leaves the solder wave; a red dashed line inside it marks the 2 mm absolute minimum. A small surface-mount part sits just outside the keep-out, pointing at the pins rather than lying side-on to them.

g.text: 3 mm; 5 mm on the side leaving the wave
Pointing at the pins, not side-on
Drawn to scale, solder side. Dimensions in mm from the outer edge of the through-hole pads.
PCB-DFA-043. Ask your assembler which side the board leaves the wave.
